name: Mizuse Asami
source:
The heroine of this story. A 25-year-old woman who works investigating molestation cases. She is highly ambitious and one of the elite members of her organization.

She didn’t think much of her breast size as a student, often being teased by the boys in the school. But ever since she started this job, she has become proud of what she’s got.

She has a high sense of pride and is strong-willed no matter who she is interacting with. But despite this, she easily crumbles when persistently teased.

She has no experience with men and thinks sex is impure.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1501]MangaGamer[/url]]
